findings.name: Dependency graph covers less than half of the components
findings.description: More than 50% of the components with a bom-ref appear nowhere in dependencies[] - neither as a graph node nor as a dependsOn target - which means the resolver or lockfile that would have connected them did not run.
findings.message: Only 104 of 344 components appear in the dependency graph (69.8% uncovered); the BOM reads like a flat list of declarations
findings.mitigation: Run the ecosystem resolver before generating the BOM (or let cdxgen --install-deps drive it) so transitive edges are captured, then re-scan
